root_cause.text: In ntfs_fill_super(), the code assigns NULL to fc->fs_private without freeing the allocated ntfs_mount_options structure, causing ntfs_fs_free() to skip its deallocation and resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "In ntfs_fill_super(), the fc->fs_private pointer is set to NULL without first freeing the memory it points to. This causes the subsequent call to ntfs_fs_free() to skip freeing the ntfs_mount_options structure." The patch removes the line `fc->fs_private = NULL;` from the function.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use put_mount_options() to properly release mount options, fixing potential memory leaks from incomplete manual cleanup.
intent_record.what: Replaced manual cleanup of mount options (unload_nls, kfree of nls_name and options structure) with a single call to put_mount_options().
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now uses the VFS helper put_mount_options() to release the mount options structure and its associated resources, ensuring consistent and complete cleanup instead of manually freeing specific fields.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove premature NULL assignment to fc->fs_private to prevent memory leak of options structure.
intent_record.what: Removed the assignment `fc->fs_private = NULL;` from the ntfs_fill_super function after copying options to sbi->options.
intent_record.how: The fs_context private data pointer is no longer set to NULL, so the options structure remains referenced by the fs_context for proper cleanup when the context is freed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Refactor mount options cleanup to use the standard put_mount_options() helper.
intent_record.what: Replaced manual cleanup of mount options (unload_nls, kfree nls_name, kfree options) with a single call to put_mount_options(sbi->options).
intent_record.how: The error/exit path in ntfs_fill_super now delegates cleanup of the mount options structure to the common put_mount_options() function instead of directly freeing its components.

commit cd39981fb92adf0cc736112f87e3e61602baa415
Author: Konstantin Komarov <almaz.alexandrovich@paragon-software.com>
Date:   Wed May 11 19:58:36 2022 +0300

    fs/ntfs3: Fix double free on remount
    
    Pointer to options was freed twice on remount
    Fixes xfstest generic/361
    Fixes: 82cae269cfa9 ("fs/ntfs3: Add initialization of super block")
    
    Signed-off-by: Konstantin Komarov <almaz.alexandrovich@paragon-software.com>

diff --git a/fs/ntfs3/super.c b/fs/ntfs3/super.c
index 27
bic_trace_step.reason: The diff shows that in ntfs_fill_super(), the patch adds 'sbi->options = fc->fs_private; fc->fs_private = NULL;' which properly transfers ownership of the options to sbi->options before clearing fc->fs_private, preventing the memory leak described in the root cause. Additionally, in ntfs_fs_reconfigure(), it replaces memcpy with swap to avoid double free. The vulnerable construct (assigning NULL without saving the pointer) is removed, so the vulnerability is fixed.
